title: [Dependabot] GHSA-p423-j2cm-9vmq in cryptography
description:
## Cryptography vulnerable to buffer overflow if non-contiguous buffers were passed to APIs

**Provider:** GitHub Dependabot
**Repository:** `AnthusAI/Biblicus`
**Alert Number:** 76
**Severity:** medium
**State:** open
**Package:** `cryptography`
**Ecosystem:** `pip`
**Manifest:** `poetry.lock`

### Advisory
If a non-contiguous buffer was passed to APIs which accepted Python buffers (e.g. `Hash.update()`), this could lead to buffer overflows. For example:

```python
h = Hash(SHA256())
b.update(buf[::-1])
```

would read past the end of the buffer on Python >3.11

### Reference
- https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/security/dependabot/76
